# tenure party

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureParty`](gmeow-tenureParty.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureParty>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The party (person, corporation, indigenous community, or other agent) that holds the rights recorded by this [`LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md). Functional: a single tenure has exactly one party. Joint ownership is modelled as multiple co-equal [`LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) instances, none privileged ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenureParty`](gmeow-tenureParty.md) from [`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

[`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single party holding the tenure's rights; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding joint ownership as multiple values — model it as multiple co-equal [`LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) instances ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:tenureParty`](gmeow-tenureParty.md) (an [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)) per [`LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md).
